description: This file provides API service functions for interacting with a backend service related to video subtitle repositioning. It includes functions to get backend URL, join URLs, extract filenames from headers, read blobs as text, and perform subtitle repositioning via an XMLHttpRequest with progress tracking.

methods.name: getBackendBaseUrl()
methods.description: Retrieves the backend base URL from environment variables or window object; defaults to empty string for same-origin requests.

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Concatenates base URL and path segments, ensuring a single slash between them.

methods.name: extractFilenameFromDisposition(disposition)
methods.description: Attempts to extract filename from Content-Disposition header, decoding RFC5987 encoding if necessary.

methods.name: readBlobAsText(blob)
methods.description: Reads a Blob object as text, returning a Promise that resolves to the text content.

methods.name: repositionSubtitles(videoFile, subtitleFile, onProgress)
methods.description: Uploads video and subtitle files to backend /reposition endpoint, tracks upload progress, handles response to extract filename, and returns a promise with the repositioned subtitle blob.
